Plot fine-mapping results

Source: R/plot.fineMap.R
plot.fineMap.Rd

Produces a ggplot2 LOD profile for each fine-mapped QTL / marker. Each QTL is shown in its own facet panel with two labelled reference points:

Peak

The grid position with the maximum LOD score, shown in peak.col.

QTL

The original QTL / marker position (centre of the fine-mapping window) as returned by qtlAim / gwasAim, shown in qtl.col with a vertical dashed reference line. Suppressed when the peak coincides with the original position.

Labels are placed with ggrepel to avoid overlap.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'fineMap'
plot(
  x,
  col = "steelblue",
  peak.col = "firebrick",
  qtl.col = "navy",
  ref.col = qtl.col,
  ncol = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An object of class "fineMap" produced by fineMap.

col

Line colour. Default "steelblue".

peak.col

Colour for the fine-map peak point and label. Default "firebrick".

qtl.col

Colour for the original QTL reference point, label, and vertical dashed line. Default "navy".

ref.col

Colour of the vertical dashed reference line. Defaults to qtl.col.

ncol

Number of columns in the facet_wrap layout. Defaults to NULL, which uses min(n_qtl, 4) columns (so up to four QTL appear on one row; five or more wrap automatically).

...

Currently ignored.

Value

A ggplot object (invisibly) with attribute suggested_height giving an appropriate plot height in inches. The plot is also printed.

See also

fineMap, print.fineMap
